# Demographic and baseline characteristics

::: {#tbl-demographics}

```{r}
#| label: demographics

tlf_output(tlf_demographics(adsl), "demographics")
```

`{r} tlf_caption("demographics")`

:::

```{r}
#| label: demographics-numbers

age_mean <- mean(adsl[["AGE"]])
female <- sum(adsl[["SEX"]] == "Female")
```

The treatment groups were comparable at baseline.
The mean age was `r sprintf("%.1f", age_mean)` years and `r female` subjects (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * female / nrow(adsl))`) were female, with no clinically relevant imbalance between groups in age, sex, race or ethnicity.

## Medical history

::: {#tbl-medical-history}

```{r}
#| label: medical-history

tlf_output(tlf_medical_history(admh, adsl), "medical_history")
```

`{r} tlf_caption("medical_history")`

:::

Reported medical history was consistent with an elderly population and was distributed similarly across the treatment groups.
